content: Justification for the existence of attributes Ap- plicationArrayDataType . dynamicArraySizeProfile and ApplicationAr- rayElement . arraySizeHandling At the first glance, the two attributes Ap- plicationArrayDataType . dynamicArraySizeProfile and ApplicationAr- rayElement . arraySizeHandling seem equivalent. However, both are needed because they have to be used if multi dimensional variable size arrays have to be described. In this case, multiple combinations of sizes could occur which cannot be specified beforehand.
